data.name: Aizah
data.gender_notes: Aizah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who glorifies God. The name Aizah carries the meaning “Glorifying God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Aizah usually hope their child will grow to embody glorifying god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who constantly remembers and praises Allah
data.etymology: Aizah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glorifying God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aizah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عائذة
in_arabic.meaning: عائذة تعني الحماية والرعاية الإلهية للإنسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عائذة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع و ذ' والذي يعني الحماية والرعاية. يدل على معنى الرفع من الأذى والحماية من كل مكروه. في القرآن الكريم، نجد آيات تشير إلى الحماية الإلهية للإنسان، مما يعزز المعنى العميق لاسم عائذة. اسم عائذة يحمل دلالات روحانية عميقة حيث يعبر عن الثقة في الله كمدبر وحامي.

in_urdu.name: عائذہ
in_urdu.meaning: عائذہ کا مطلب ہے الہی حفاظت اور نگہداشت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عائذہ نام عربی جڑ 'ع و ذ' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت اور نگہداشت. یہ نام اس تحفظ اور بچاؤ کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے جو انسان کو ہر قسم کے نقصان سے ملتا ہے. اسلامی روایت میں، عائذہ جیسے ناموں کا انتخاب والدین کے ذریعہ اپنے بچوں کے لئے روحانی اور اخلاقی رہنمائی کی کوششوں کا اظہار ہے.

in_hindi.name: आइज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: आइज़ा का अर्थ है ईश्वरीय संरक्षण और देखभाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: आइज़ा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ع و ذ' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है संरक्षण और देखभाल. यह नाम उस सुरक्षा को दर्शाता है जो इंसान को हर तरह के नुकसान से मिलती है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, आइज़ा जैसे नामों का चयन बच्चों के लिए आध्यात्मिक और नैतिक मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करने के माता-पिता के प्रयासों को प्रकट करता है.

in_pashto.name: عائذہ
in_pashto.meaning: عائذہ د الهي حفاظت او پاملنې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عائذہ نوم په عربي ژبه کې د 'ع و ذ' جذر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د حفاظت او پاملنې معنی لري. دا نوم د هغه خوندیتوب څرګندوي چې انسان ته د هر ډول زیان څخه رسي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې، داسې نومونه لکه عائذہ د اولادو لپاره د روحاني او اخلاقي لارښوونې د هڅو څرګندونه ده.

in_english.name: Aizah
in_english.meaning: Divine protection and care; shield from harm
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aizah originates from the Arabic root 'ع و ذ' (Ain-Waw-Tha), which signifies protection, care, and preservation. It connotes the idea of being shielded from harm and receiving divine guardianship. In Islamic tradition, names like Aizah are chosen for their spiritual significance and to invoke blessings and protection upon the individual. The name Aizah reflects a profound trust in God as the ultimate protector and guardian.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: عائذہ (ah-EE-zah)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عائذہ (ah-EE-zah)

data.cultural_impact: The name Aizah, rooted in Arabic language and Islamic culture, signifies one who truly demonstrates deep reverence and glorification for God in both words and actions. This resonates deeply within the Islamic community, where the practice of submitting oneself to Allah (God) and striving to embody His divine qualities is a significant aspect of daily life and cultural norms.
data.spiritual_significance: Aizah can be considered a reminder of the importance of upholding and celebrating one's spiritual connection with Allah. It implies a continuous state of remembrance, consciousness, and gratitude towards the divine, and serves as an inspiration towards a life filled with goodness, kindness, and servitude to Allah. Aizah embodies the principles of tawheed (monotheism) and obedience to Allah, emphasizing an essential and intrinsic aspect of Islamic spirituality.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Glorifying God" symbolizes The one who glorifies God. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aizah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of glorifying god.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Aisha bint Abu Bakr As-Siddiq (R.A.) was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and one of the wives of the Prophet. She was known for her intelligence, generosity, and courage. She played a significant role in the early Islamic community and was a source of knowledge and guidance for the Prophet and the Muslims.

trends: Aisha is a popular name for girls in the Muslim world and beyond.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aizah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Layla Aizah, a teacher in Istanbul, Turkey, shares that their name Aizah meaning "Glorifying God" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
